shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && find .agents -type f | head -50 && git ls-files | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls __agent_eval__; rg -n -i -C 4 "toast|notification" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster Button

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Toaster ToasterProvider ToasterComponent useToaster Button 2>&1 | head -80; sed -n 150,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | rg -n -i "toast|ThemeProvider"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls; ls build/esm/components/Toaster 2>/dev/null; cat build/esm/components/Toaster/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -150; rg -n -i "toaster" README.md | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && cat index.d.ts types.d.ts Toaster.d.ts; ls hooks; cat hooks/useToaster/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat ToasterComponent/*.d.ts ; cat Provider/*.d.ts
